name: Aphids
signs: Clusters on tender growth, sticky honeydew, distorted leaves
favoredConditions: Soft new growth and stressed plants
firstResponse: Inspect undersides of leaves, spray with water, and protect beneficial insects

name: Cabbage Worms
signs: Chewed brassica leaves and green caterpillars near leaf veins
firstResponse: Hand-pick, use row cover early, and encourage predators

name: Flea Beetles
signs: Small shot holes in leaves, especially brassicas and eggplants
firstResponse: Use row cover, transplant sturdy seedlings, and reduce weed hosts

name: Squash Bugs
signs: Wilting cucurbit leaves, bronze egg clusters, nymphs under leaves
favoredConditions: Dense squash plantings and overwintering debris
firstResponse: Scout leaf undersides, remove eggs, and rotate cucurbit beds

name: Slugs
signs: Ragged holes, slime trails, damage on seedlings and low leaves
favoredConditions: Cool damp mulch, dense cover, and poor airflow
firstResponse: Reduce hiding places near seedlings, water in morning, and use traps selectively
